name: Curvy Frog 97
author: Yaya12085
description: Neon pill pink toggle switch that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: On hover, box-shadow becomes 0 0 0px 8px #000000, box-shadow becomes 0 0 0px 8px #ec4899. Clicking it toggles it: background-color changes from #64748b to #ec4899, box-shadow becomes 0 0 0px 8px #ec4899, transform becomes translateX(100%).
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Curvy Frog 97</title>
<style>
/* Curvy Frog 97 by Yaya12085 — https://uiverse.io/Yaya12085/curvy-frog-97 */
.switch {
  position: relative;
  height: 1.5rem;
  width: 3rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  appearance: none;
  -webkit-appearance: none;
  border-radius: 9999px;
  background-color: rgba(100, 116, 139, 0.377);
  transition: all .3s ease;
}

.switch:checked {
  background-color: rgba(236, 72, 153, 1);
}

.switch::before {
  position: absolute;
  content: "";
  left: calc(1.5rem - 1.6rem);
  top: calc(1.5rem - 1.6rem);
  display: block;
  height: 1.6rem;
  width: 1.6rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  border: 1px solid rgba(100, 116, 139, 0.527);
  border-radius: 9999px;
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1);
  box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(100, 116, 139, 0.327);
  transition: all .3s ease;
}

.switch:hover::before {
  box-shadow: 0 0 0px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, .15)
}

.switch:checked:hover::before {
  box-shadow: 0 0 0px 8px rgba(236, 72, 153, .15)
}

.switch:checked:before {
  transform: translateX(100%);
  border-color: rgba(236, 72, 153, 1);
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<input class="switch" type="checkbox" checked="true">

</body>
</html>
